description: This file contains core functions for a behavioral observation software project (BORIS). It includes functions for checking observation and project integrity, handling file paths, exporting data, and managing project data, observations, and media files. It interacts with various project components such as ethogram, observations, subjects, and media information, and includes utility functions for data validation, file handling, and exporting observations in different formats.

methods.name: float check_observation_exhaustivity( events: List[list], state_events_list: list = [], )
methods.description: Calculates the observation exhaustivity percentage based on events and state events list, assessing the coverage of behavioral observations over time.

methods.name: float check_observation_exhaustivity_pictures(obs)
methods.description: Evaluates the exhaustivity percentage for coded images in observations, based on the number of images and coded images.

methods.name: Dict[str,str] behavior_category(ethogram: dict)
methods.description: Returns a dictionary mapping behavior codes to their respective behavioral categories from the ethogram.

methods.name: Tuple[bool,str] check_if_media_available(observation: dict, project_file_name: str)
methods.description: Checks if media or image files are available for a given observation, returning a boolean and a message.

methods.name: Tuple[bool,str] check_directories_availability(observation: dict, project_file_name: str)
methods.description: Verifies that specified directories exist for an observation.

methods.name: bool check_coded_behaviors_in_obs_list(pj: dict, observations_list: list)
methods.description: Validates that behaviors coded in observations are defined in the ethogram, displaying a dialog if not.

methods.name: list get_modifiers_of_behavior(ethogram, behavior: str)
methods.description: Retrieves all modifiers associated with a specific behavior from the ethogram.

methods.name: set check_coded_behaviors(pj: dict)
methods.description: Returns a set of behaviors found in observations that are not defined in the ethogram.

methods.name: Tuple[bool,str] check_state_events_obs(obsId: str, ethogram: dict, observation: dict, time_format: str = cfg.HHMMSS)
methods.description: Validates state events within a specific observation for correct pairing and definition.

methods.name: Tuple[bool,tuple] check_state_events(pj: dict, observations_list: list)
methods.description: Checks a list of observations for unpaired state events, prompting user action.

methods.name: str check_project_integrity( pj: dict, time_format: str, project_file_name: str, media_file_available: bool = True, )
methods.description: Performs multiple integrity checks on the project, including behaviors, unpaired events, timestamps, media, and subjects.

methods.name: Tuple[bool,str] create_subtitles(pj: dict, selected_observations: list, parameters: dict, export_dir: str)
methods.description: Creates subtitle files for selected observations, retrieving data from a database and formatting it for export.

methods.name: bool export_observations_list(pj: dict, selected_observations: list, file_name: str, output_format: str)
methods.description: Exports a list of selected observations into various formats like CSV, TSV, HTML, XLS, XLSX, ODS.

methods.name: bool set_media_paths_relative_to_project_dir(pj: dict, project_file_name: str)
methods.description: Adjusts media and image directory paths to be relative to the project file location.

methods.name: bool set_data_paths_relative_to_project_dir(pj: dict, project_file_name: str)
methods.description: Makes data file paths relative to the project directory.

methods.name: None remove_data_files_path(pj: dict)
methods.description: Removes file paths from data entries in the project.

methods.name: bool remove_media_files_path(pj: dict, project_file_name: str)
methods.description: Strips file paths from media entries in the project, optionally prompting user confirmation.

methods.name: str full_path(path: str, project_file_name: str)
methods.description: Constructs the full file or directory path, considering relative paths to the project location.

methods.name: Tuple[dec,dec] observed_interval(observation: dict)
methods.description: Calculates the start and end times of observed events for an observation.

methods.name: List[tuple] events_start_stop(ethogram: dict, events: list, obs_type: str)
methods.description: Annotates events with start/stop or point status based on behavior and subject, considering behavior type.

methods.name: list extract_observed_subjects(pj: dict, selected_observations: list)
methods.description: Extracts a list of unique subjects observed across selected observations.

methods.name: tuple open_project_json(project_file_name: str)
methods.description: Opens and loads a BORIS project file (.json or gzipped), updating version info and migrating old formats as needed.

methods.name: str|None event_type(code: str, ethogram: dict)
methods.description: Returns the type ('state' or 'point') of an event based on its behavior code by looking up the ethogram.

methods.name: list fix_unpaired_state_events(ethogram: dict, observation: dict, fix_at_time: dec)
methods.description: Fixes unpaired state events in an observation by adding closing events at a specified time, ensuring proper pairing of start and end events within an observation.

methods.name: list fix_unpaired_state_events2(ethogram: dict, events: list, fix_at_time: dec)
methods.description: Fixes unpaired state events within a list of events, adding missing ending events at a specified time to correct unpaired states.

methods.name: bool has_audio(observation: dict, media_file_path: str)
methods.description: Checks whether a media observation contains audio content based on media info metadata.

methods.name: None explore_project(self)
methods.description: Provides a GUI-based tool to search for specific subjects, behaviors, modifiers, or comments across all observations in the project; displays results with double-click to load observation at a given event.

methods.name: Tuple[str,pd.DataFrame] project2dataframe(pj: dict, observations_list: list = [])
methods.description: Converts the project's observations and related data into a pandas DataFrame for analysis or export, including handling independent variables, behaviors, modifiers, and event segmentation.

methods.name: double_click_explore_project(obs_id, event_idx)
methods.description: unavailable

methods.name: dec interval_len(interval: I)

methods.name: Tuple[str,str] subject_color(subject: str)
